messages:
Juno: Heads-up, legal flagged some confusing wording in the Compliance -> Storage card. Can we do a quick sweep for copy + a11y?
Cam: Sure. What did they call out specifically?
Juno: Two things: 1) "Retention" label is leading to support tickets — people ask what the start date is. 2) The tiny KMS badge just says "Encrypted". Legal wants clear ownership language.
Riya: For retention let's be explicit: 'Retention (starts on creation)'. Short and obvious.
Marco: I like that. Also suggest a one-line helper: 'Automatically deletes content after this period.' Keep it on hover on mobile.
Cam: Noted. For the KMS badge, legal suggested "Customer-managed key (KMS)" vs "Redwood-managed key". We should avoid 'managed' ambiguity.
Riya: Maybe 'Encrypted — Customer KMS' and 'Encrypted — Redwood KMS'. Easy to scan.
infra-bot: Deploy note: UI component "status-badge" used in multiple pages. Changing text will affect layout in Settings and API Keys pages.
Marco: Good call. We need a compact variant for narrow widths: show icon + short text, full text in tooltip/modal.
accessibility-bot: Automated check: decorative lock icon has role=presentation but no accessible label on badge. This makes the badge read as "Encrypted" by screen readers with no ownership detail. Recommend aria-label="Encrypted — Customer-managed key (KMS)".
Cam: Add tabindex and aria-describedby pointing to the helper text? That should surface it to SRs.
Riya: Also audit log button copy is "Download CSV" which legal thinks is vague. They want "Export audit log (CSV)" so it's explicit.
Juno: Another log nit: events sometimes say "token rotated" vs "API key rotated". Standardize to "API key rotated".
Marco: Mobile UX — the retention range slider wraps badly at 320px. Suggest we swap to a select on small screens.
Cam: Implementation note: changing the badge aria-label and adding select for mobile is ~3-4 hrs. Icon contrast needs bump too.
accessibility-bot: Contrast advisory: current lock glyph AA fails on light mode. Suggest color #0747a6 or similar. Also ensure focus outline appears when badge is keyboard-focused.
Riya: Can we add a tiny "key info" link next to the badge that opens a modal explaining KMS options, rotation, and contact for key escrow? Legal wants the FAQ link in that modal.
Juno: Yes, include link. Also, region fallback messaging: when we fallback show "Using fallback region: us-east-1 (primary eu-west-1 unavailable)" not just "Fallback".
Marco: I'll prototype the compact badge + modal. Cam, can you confirm wording so I can mock?
Cam: Draft final strings: 1) Retention label: "Retention (starts on creation)" helper: "Data removed after this period." 2) Badge: visible: "Encrypted — Customer KMS" aria-label same text. 3) Audit button: "Export audit log (CSV)" 4) Region fallback text as Juno suggested.
infra-bot: Reminder: changing aria-labels will bump translations. Notify i18n team.
Riya: I'll prepare a short copy doc and ping i18n. Also will add the FAQ link URL for the modal.
Marco: Plan: mock in Figma today, quick staging flag tomorrow, accessibility smoke test after deploy.
Juno: Thanks. If anyone runs into conflicts with status-badge consumer pages, loop me in.
Cam: I'll update the component API to accept a11yLabel prop and compactLayout prop.
accessibility-bot: Follow-up scan: if implemented as discussed, badge will expose ownership to assistive tech and keyboard users. Manual SR check recommended.
Juno: Perfect. Aim to land these before the compliance doc final review tomorrow.
